messages:
maya: apiserver 503 spike in eu-west1, lots of controller-manager retries. seeing NAT timeouts reported from proxy logs :fire_engine:
adrian: logs?
maya: past 5m: 35% 503s, apiserver latency tail up to 1.8s. proxy shows `connection reset by peer` + SNAT exhausted on nat-gw-2. snippets:
```
proxy: dial tcp 10.3.4.12:6443: i/o timeout
nat-gw-2: port exhaustion, active 65531/65535
etcd follower xfer-latency spike: wal fsync latencies 200-400ms
```
jess: hmm, if NAT is exhausting ports we'll see half-open connections causing apiserver to pile up watchers, which can cause watch fanout CPU + controller queue backlog.
neil: confirm: controller-manager showing requeue/backoff?
maya: yeah controller-manager logs show exponential backoff on PodSync loops, backlog ~4200 items. leader election churn also increased.
sre-bot: [ALERT] apiserver_503_rate eu-west1 > 25% for 4m
adrian: check kube-proxy conn track and kube-apiserver keepalives. if keepalive isn't closing then ports stick.
maya: kube-proxy conntrack high: tcp_established 210k -> 360k in 3m. NAT gw metrics: SNAT table full, retries to same nat-ip.
ops-runner: deploy-bot shows no recent controlplane deploys in the last hour.
deploy-bot: [CI] no controlplane deploys detected for 2h
jess: short mitigations: 1) scale nat-gw-2 (add extra eips) 2) rotate apiserver proxy routes to nat-gw-1/3 3) temporary reduce watch QPS on controllers via env var 4) enable iptables conntrack cleanup aggressive mode.
adrian: agree. also raise `tcp_fin_timeout` on proxy nodes? or reduce keepalive interval to free ports faster.
neil: cost tradeoffs: scaling nat-gw horizontally adds elastic IPs (cheap), but long-term we should add regional proxy egress via NAT pooling to avoid single gw saturation.
maya: initiating quick actions: adding 2 EIPs to nat-gw-2 now, routing 25% traffic to nat-gw-3.
jess: can you also roll kube-proxy to pick up conntrack params? small rolling restart of nodes in eu-west1 with drained pods.
maya: starting node-drain batch-1 (3 nodes) now :eyes:
adrian: while draining, watch etcd follower metrics. we saw WAL fsync spikes earlier — could be IOPS noise on underlying disks coincident with SNAT retry storms.
ops-runner: scheduling a quick dd iops test on affected etcd nodes after drain window.
maya: dd+iostat shows occasional 150ms fsyncs on etcd-vol-02, correlates with times of highest watch churn.
neil: could be noisy neighbor on storage host. file a support ticket with provider and open a temporary patch: increase etcd election timeout to reduce churn and leader election thrash.
jess: action items concise:
- maya: complete nat-gw scale & route shift (in progress)
- adrian: prepare kube-proxy conntrack roll with new sysctls
- neil: open provider support ticket for disk IOPS + propose long-term: regional egress pooling design
- ops-runner: run post-mitigation load test and collect metrics (conntrack, snat, etcd fsync, apiserver tail latency)
maya: nat-gw scale done, traffic shifted 25% -> nat-gw-3, immediate 503s dropped to 9% and tail latency down to 420ms. controller backlog dropping slowly.
adrian: starting kube-proxy roll with sysctl changes: `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=180` and `net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30` on eu-west1 nodes.
sre-bot: [INFO] kube-proxy rollout started by adrian
neil: support ticket created: INC-2091 (storage host noisy neighbor), attached iostat and dd logs. provider suggested temporary resize or move volumes.
jess: if disk IOPS persists we should consider moving etcd replicas to a different AZ or using gp3 with higher iops. cost estimate?
neil: rough monthly delta ~ $1500 for gp3 iops bump for cluster. cheaper than prolonged incident + degraded SLOs.
maya: controller backlog now 430 -> 80 in 12m. leader election frequency normalized. apiserver 503s stabilized under 2% for last 3m.
adrian: follow-up: we'll get a small runbook entry for NAT SNAT exhaustion patterns + quick mitigations (EIP add, route shift, conntrack sysctls). jess can you own the runbook?
jess: I got it. will draft and add to runbooks repo, include playbook and cost notes.
ops-runner: marking thread resolved but keeping monitoring for 2h.
sre-bot: [RECOVERY] apiserver_503_rate eu-west1 < 2%
maya: thanks team, nice quick coordination.
